partial: Visible process totals are partial. n/a = unavailable.
search: Search name, executable or exact PID · Enter: table · Esc: reset
filter_status: {shown} shown · {matching} matching / {total} rows · charts: whole system
net_explanation: Net used = total − available · Other = accounting residual.
chart_note: Last 60 samples · 0–100% · blank = no reading · pause between scans {interval}s
enter_group: Enter: explore processes in this group.
source: Source: kernel metadata; process memory contents are not read.
capture_count: {count} sample(s) · includes paths and metadata, never RAM contents
path_changed: The path changed: select Save first.
file_exists: File exists. Change the path or choose Replace file.
wait_write: Wait for the write to finish.
rss_unavailable: RSS map n/a: missing readings; see the table.
zero_rss: Measured RSS: 0 B in displayed regions.
region_search: File, type, permissions or 0x address… · Enter: table
uss_coverage: Top 10 among {complete}/{total} apps with complete USS · processes with USS {measured}/{processes}
uss_pid_unavailable: Process USS unavailable in RAM sample
uss_pid_note: USS {percent}% of total RAM; position is illustrative
uss_app_note: Scale: USS of complete apps only; excludes partial groups, shared memory and kernel. Groups follow the table; blocks are not physical addresses.
region_scale_note: Consumption shares, not physical addresses. Below: virtual ranges of this PID only; separate on-demand sample.
region_virtual_note: Increasing virtual addresses · │ gaps excluded from scale.
region_resident_note: Area proportional to RSS · virtual order; shared pages may repeat.
region_no_match: No matching region. /: search · f: filters · Esc: reset or back.
detail_fixed: Sample fixed when opened. Close and reopen to refresh. Esc / d: close.
detail_source: Linux smaps_rollup: byte counts converted for display.
detail_unsupported: Linux breakdown unavailable from the {platform} backend; details remain n/a.
detail_group_count: {count} processes; filters and search retain every group member.
ram_overlap_note: RAM bar: used / available. Cache, pools and commit overlap; they are not additive segments.
os_breakdown_missing: OS breakdown n/a: {reason}. Bar: used / available.
os_counters_missing: counters not exposed by this backend
linux_commit_note: Cache and slab overlap the bar categories. Commit is committed virtual memory, not resident RAM or swap; the limit depends on overcommit settings.
windows_cache_pool: System cache {cache} · Paged kernel pool {paged} · nonpaged {nonpaged}
windows_memory_note: Cache includes standby and the system working set and overlaps available RAM. Paged pool measures allocation, not just residency. Commit is committed virtual memory, not resident RAM or swap. Readings are sequential.
unsupported_process_counters: Per-process PSS / Swap / SwapPSS: n/a on this backend. RSS and USS where readable.
swap_filter_unsupported: Per-process swap unavailable on this system; filter has no results.
no_matches: No matches. /: search · f: filters · Esc: reset or return to apps.
detail_desc_shared_clean: Shared clean RSS pages, not a PSS share
detail_desc_shared_dirty: Shared dirty RSS pages, not a PSS share
detail_desc_anonymous: Anonymous resident pages, already included in RSS counters
detail_desc_lazy_free: Pages marked MADV_FREE, reclaimable by the kernel
detail_desc_anon_huge_pages: Anonymous THP pages, already included in the other views
detail_components_missing: complete readings {complete}/{total}; missing components or members
detail_components_inconsistent: components inconsistent with the total of at least one process
detail_notes:
Each bar has its own total; do not add PSS and RSS. Swap is separate from resident RAM.
Rows are overlapping views: do not add them all. Anonymous/file/shmem PSS partitions PSS;
private clean + dirty gives USS. Shared clean/dirty is shared RSS and may be counted
more than once in groups. A single missing field makes that row’s total n/a.
THP is included in ordinary counters; explicit HugeTLB remains excluded.
comparison_hint: v: metric · s: sort · f: filters · b: fix A · r: B · c: current view
comparison_no_intervals: No comparable interval. Check origin, coverage and filters.
comparison_caution: The same interval does not prove the same allocation; growth does not prove a leak.
region_notice_baseline_complete: A complete sample is required to fix A.
region_notice_need_samples: Fix A and capture B to compare.
region_origin_missing: offset / inode n/a on this provider
region_type_caution: Type = origin/heuristic; files may include private CoW pages. THP included; HugeTLB separate. No contents read.
cli_ignored_value: this option does not accept the value {value}
cli_one_required: one of the arguments {arguments} is required
cli_invalid_interval: interval must be finite and at least 0.25 seconds
cli_description: RAM monitor for Linux, Windows and macOS · Python + Textual
cli_help_help: show this help message and exit
cli_help_json: print one JSON sample and exit
cli_help_open: open a saved capture without live sampling
cli_help_compare: compare two files, each containing one sample
cli_help_processes: open the UI in process view
cli_help_language: interface and report language: it, en, zh, ko, fr, vi, es, pt, de, ja
cli_help_budget: optional budget: maximum processes measured per cycle
cli_help_priority: with a budget, give limited priority to the PID selected in the UI
cli_help_backoff: with a budget, temporarily defer repeatedly slow or denied reads
cli_sample_coverage: Readable PSS: {measured}/{total} processes · identities unavailable/exited: {skipped} · {duration} ms
cli_sample_warning: Incomplete totals = n/a. RSS and Swap may count shared pages more than once.
cli_sample_backend: Backend: RSS / USS available; psutil does not expose per-process PSS or swap.
cli_budget_requires_live: --max-measurements is only available for live monitoring
cli_compare_single: --compare requires one sample per file; use --open for a saved comparison
capture_control_characters: {name}: control characters or surrogates are not allowed
capture_coverage_pair: {name}: coverage must contain observed and expected counts
capture_region_count: invalid region count or region limit exceeded
capture_overlapping_regions: regions overlap or are out of order
capture_unrepresentable_date: taken: timestamp cannot be represented on this system
capture_coverage_regions: {metric} coverage does not match the regions
capture_count_invalid: the file must contain one or two captures
capture_same_baseline: Baseline A and the current sample are identical: refresh B or remove the baseline before saving
tech_unsupported_system: Unsupported system: {platform}. Supported: Linux, Windows, macOS.
tech_budget_positive: Measurement budget must be a positive integer
tech_budget_unsupported: Backend does not support budgeted sampling
tech_budget_required: Priority and backoff require a measurement budget
tech_smaps_size_mismatch: Size does not match region addresses
tech_process_smaps_missing: Process exited, PID reused or smaps unavailable
tech_partition_missing: RAM breakdown unavailable: missing meminfo fields ({fields})
tech_partition_bad_totals: RAM breakdown unavailable: negative meminfo counters or zero total
tech_partition_cached_shmem: RAM breakdown unavailable: inconsistent sample (Cached < Shmem)
tech_partition_excess: RAM breakdown unavailable: counters sum exceeds MemTotal
tech_pss_unsupported: PSS not exposed by psutil on this system
tech_swap_unsupported: per-process swap not exposed; commit/pagefile is not equivalent to swap on disk
tech_swappss_unsupported: SwapPSS not exposed by psutil on this system
tech_global_swap_windows: Global swap: pagefile from psutil; not process private commit
tech_available_macos: Available from psutil: free + inactive; different from Activity Monitor Memory Pressure
tech_uss_denied: USS: access denied or reading unavailable
tech_rollup_absent: smaps_rollup absent: process exited, kernel thread or unsupported kernel
tech_windows64_required: Experimental Windows provider requires 64-bit Windows Python
tech_systeminfo_missing: GetSystemInfo did not provide usable limits
tech_region_residency_unavailable: Per-region residency is not yet available.
tech_address_limits: invalid address limits or page size
ram_value_note: Hardware allocation, not a bill. PSS apportions shared memory; USS excludes it.
